runningHint: The proxy is running. You can open your game client.
stoppedHint: Start the proxy before opening your game client.
startingHint: Checking plugins and starting the proxy. Please wait.
noLogs: No logs yet. Messages will appear here when Toolbox starts.
updateFailed: {failed} plugin updates failed. Check the logs.
updateError: Plugin update check did not finish. Check the logs.
author: Author
configurationOnly: Enabled is a saved configuration, not a live load status.
update: Update available. Restart Toolbox to apply.
modLocked: Stop Toolbox before installing or uninstalling plugins.
legacyHint: Legacy plugin: enable and update settings are unavailable.
uninstallQuestion: Uninstall “{name}”? Its files and saved settings will be removed.
applyNext: Enable changes take effect the next time the proxy starts.
logEmptyHint: Start Toolbox to see its output. Clearing this view does not delete log files.
themeHint: Selected color anchors window, sidebar, card and button layers with readable text contrast.
backgroundHint: Use a built-in image, looping video or local media as the interface background.
missingBackground: This background is unavailable. Using the built-in wallpaper.
pageAcrylicHint: Adds frosted blur behind tool pages and the Home log card.
pageSemiTransparentHint: Lets you tune background blur strength below; uses maximum strength when off.
pageOpacityHint: Sets background blur strength behind tool pages and the Home log card.
frameOpacityHint: Controls only the left navigation sidebar background density.
backgroundOpacityHint: Controls visibility of background images or videos; lower values show more base color.
backgroundDimHint: Adds a black darkening shade over wallpaper or video (including splash).
panelOpacityHint: Controls background fill density for panels and info cards.
reducedMotionHint: Turn off interface and startup animations. This setting works independently of system motion settings.
rawHTMLHint: Enable to show the original HTML in logs; disable to show safely formatted text and links.
startupHint: Control Toolbox startup, the success sound and window behavior.
startupSoundHint: Play a notification sound once the Toolbox proxy starts successfully. Disabling this also stops any startup sound currently playing.
windowSizeHint: Set the width and height of the normal window here. Edge resizing is unavailable; maximize and restore remain available.
windowSaveHint: Click Apply to use and save the width and height. Other settings save automatically.
window-size: Enter whole-number dimensions within the current display range.
window-failed: Could not save or apply the window size. Check the configuration file permissions.
window-denied: This window cannot change the window size.
updateHint: Control Toolbox and plugin auto-updates separately and choose whether to show detailed update logs. Keeping auto-updates enabled is recommended.

background-size: The file is too large. Images / GIF: 12 MB maximum; MP4: 128 MB maximum.
background-type: Choose a valid PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or MP4 file.
background-decode: This file cannot be decoded here, is damaged, or exceeds 8192 px / 32 megapixels. Try another image or H.264 MP4. Your previous background is unchanged.
background-failed: Could not import or save the background. Check the file and folder permissions. Your previous background is unchanged.
background-denied: This window cannot change the background.
bridgeMissing: Open this interface through TERA Toolbox. It needs the desktop IPC bridge.
cleanstart: Clear logs when starting the proxy
noslstags: Hide proxy tags in the server list
warningMods: Disabling plugin updates can break compatibility. Re-enable updates to receive fixes.
warningSelf: Disabling Toolbox updates stops program, protocol and security fixes. Re-enable updates to stay supported.
selfUpdateErrorHelp: TERA Toolbox was unable to update itself. If the problem persists, ask here {supportUrl} for help!
updateServerError:
TERA Toolbox was unable to check for updates on server {serverIndex}!
{error}
updateServersError:
TERA Toolbox was unable to check for updates using any server!
This is most likely an issue caused by your internet connection or your system configuration.
updateAntivirusHint:
Your anti-virus software most likely falsely detected TERA Toolbox to be a virus.
Please whitelist it!
updateGameRunningHint:
This is most likely caused by an instance of the game client that is still running.
Close all game clients or restart your computer, then try again!
electronUpdateErrorHelp: TERA Toolbox was unable to update Electron. If the problem persists, ask here {supportUrl} for help!
programTerminated: The program will now be terminated.
serversHint: Save launchers and backgrounds for different servers.
noServersHint: Each profile keeps one server’s launcher and background together.
removeServerQuestion: Remove the profile for {serverName}? Its launcher files will be kept.
launcherPathHint: Open this server’s launcher once Toolbox is ready. This feature requires running Toolbox as administrator to launch the game launcher.
serverBackgroundHint: Used when this server is selected; otherwise the global background applies.
serverBackgroundMissing: This server image is unavailable. Using the global background.
launcherAfterStartup: Toolbox will open the {serverName} launcher once ready.
launcherChecking: Checking whether the {serverName} launcher or a game is running…
launcherAlreadyRunning: The {serverName} launcher is already running. Only Toolbox was started.
launcherGameRunning: A game is already running. Only Toolbox was started.
launcherUnconfigured: No launcher is set for {serverName}. Choose one in Game client settings.
launcherRunningHint: Selected: {serverName}. Stopping Toolbox leaves the game and launcher open, but may disconnect the game.
launcher-path: The launcher EXE is invalid or has moved. Choose its EXE again.
launcher-check-failed: Could not confirm the running processes. Launcher opening was skipped. Check process access and try again.
launcher-failed: Could not open the launcher. Check its path and permissions.
server-name: Enter a single-line server name with 1–80 characters.
server-invalid: This server profile is unavailable. Select an existing profile.
server-failed: Could not save the server profile. Check configuration file permissions.
server-denied: This window cannot change server profiles.
background-target: The target server profile is unavailable. Select it again.
